Aspect Ratio Fixes v{version}
https://github.com/sonochiwa/sa-aspect-ratio-fixes

GTA San Andreas 1.0 US plugin. Requires an ASI loader.

Installation
  Extract AspectRatioFixes.asi and AspectRatioFixes.ini into the game
  directory or its scripts directory, then start the game.

Type ASPECTFIXES in game to reload the INI.

Created by sonochiwa. MIT license.
